newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Central Norseman sees gold yield rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Central Norseman sees gold yield rise.

text.p: Central Norseman Gold Corp said on Friday it produced 36,323 ounces of gold in the December quarter, up 7,074 ounces on the previous quarter, when a series of planned mill shutdowns restricted mining.
The Western Australia miner also said it intends to commence mining of the Iron King open cut deposit next month, subject to final approvals.
The mine, located six kms south of the town of Norseman, should yield 15,000 ounces over a six month milling period, Central Norseman said.

Central Norseman said 195,612 ounces of gold sales have been hedged, with maturities extending to June 2001 at an average price of US$422 an ounce using a combination of forward contracts, spot deferred contracts and options.
Central Norseman is 48 percent owned by WMC Ltd.
